author: Codex, separate from the Claude implementation agent. Prior development reports and implementation review context were available; this is not a fully independent external evaluation.

limitations: Two distinct domain models plus a paired normal counterpart, not three independent domains.
Synthetic author-defined defects do not establish real-world zero-day discovery.
